name: Dry January
join_only_if: you offer alcohol-free options or support people taking part
angle_1: Your alcohol-free menu or range
angle_2: Social plans that don't need a drink
risk: Alcohol brands should sit this out. No health claims.

name: Veganuary
fit: Food and drink, F&B, grocery, wellness
join_only_if: you sell or make plant-based products, or your team is genuinely taking part
angle_1: Your best plant-based picks, honestly labelled
angle_2: One simple swap a day for a week
risk: No health claims you can't prove. Don't call a product vegan unless it is.

name: International Day of Education
join_only_if: you teach, fund learning or make learning tools
angle_1: A free lesson or resource from your team
angle_2: The teacher who changed your founder's path
angle_3: How your product helps someone learn
risk: Avoid making it a sales post.

name: Black History Month (US)
organiser: Theme set by ASALH, the Association for the Study of African American Life and History
ask: Learn, celebrate and support Black communities
fit: Any US brand with a genuine connection: founders, partners, community work
join_only_if: you can show real support beyond February: partners, suppliers, giving, people
angle_1: Spotlight a Black-owned partner or supplier, with their consent
angle_2: Share what you're reading or funding
angle_3: Hand the mic to someone from your community
risk: Tokenism backfires. No logo-only posts. Watch the US political climate and keep the focus on people.

name: Safer Internet Day
organiser: Insafe network for the European Commission, with national centres such as eSafety (AU) and Netsafe (NZ)
cause: A safer, better internet, especially for young people
ask: Learn and share online safety habits
join_only_if: you build or run something people use online
angle_1: Three settings every parent should know in your app
angle_2: How you protect customer data, in plain words
risk: Don't overstate your security. Point to official guidance.

name: Zero Discrimination Day
cause: Equality before the law and in practice
fit: Employers, HR and people brands, inclusive brands
join_only_if: your policies back up what you post
angle_1: A policy you changed and why
angle_2: What inclusion looks like in your hiring
risk: Words without policies read as empty.

name: World Wildlife Day
join_only_if: you work with or near nature, or fund conservation
angle_1: A local species your customers can spot
angle_2: How you reduce your impact on habitats
risk: Avoid claims of impact you can't measure.

name: Clean Up Australia Day
date_display: Sun 7 Mar 2027 (Community clean-ups Sun 7 Mar; organiser events also on 2 and 5 Mar)
ask: Register or join a local clean-up
join_only_if: your team will actually turn up and clean up
angle_1: Invite customers to your team's clean-up
angle_2: Before and after photos of your site
angle_3: What you found and what you'll change
risk: Show the work, not the logo.

name: International Women's Day
organiser: United Nations (UN Women), with the internationalwomensday.com campaign
ask: Celebrate women and act for equality
fit: Any brand that can show real action
join_only_if: you can show women in your business, customers or supply chain, and what you're doing for equality
angle_1: Women on your team in their own words
angle_2: A number you're working to change (pay gap, promotions)
risk: Quote cards without action get called out. Check claims about pay and representation.

name: Earth Hour
date_display: Sat 20 Mar 2027 (Organiser date: 8:30 pm local time)
ask: Switch off non-essential lights for an hour
join_only_if: you will actually switch off (signs, stores, office) and can show it
angle_1: Your shopfront going dark at 8:30 pm
angle_2: What your team does in the dark hour
angle_3: One change you're keeping after the hour
risk: Switching off for an hour isn't a climate strategy. Say what else you do.

name: International Day of Happiness
organiser: United Nations, with Action for Happiness
cause: Wellbeing and happiness as a goal
ask: Do one thing that makes someone happier
join_only_if: you can add something useful, not just a smile
angle_1: One small habit your team swears by
angle_2: A customer moment that made your day
angle_3: An act of kindness you'll do today
risk: Avoid mental health claims.

name: World Water Day
join_only_if: water use is part of your business
angle_1: How much water your product or kitchen uses, and how you cut it
angle_2: A tip customers can try at home
risk: Back water-saving claims with numbers.

name: World Health Day
ask: Take one step for your health or others'
join_only_if: you have a health role and can stay within regulated claims
angle_1: Your team's lunchtime walk
angle_2: A myth your industry gets asked about, answered
risk: Health claims are regulated. Stay general and point to official advice.

name: Earth Day
cause: Environmental protection. 2027 theme: Food for Our Planet (plant-based diets and food labels)
ask: Take one action for the planet, this year on food
join_only_if: you can point to a real change in how you source, make or package
angle_1: One change you made this year, with the number
angle_2: A plant-forward dish or product, honestly labelled
angle_3: What your customers can do with leftovers or packaging
risk: Greenwashing. Every green claim needs proof.

name: Fashion Revolution Week
date_display: Sat 24 Apr 2027 (Week around 24 April; 2027 dates TBC by the organiser)
cause: A fair, transparent fashion industry; marks the Rana Plaza collapse (24 Apr 2013)
join_only_if: you can answer who made your clothes, by name or by factory
angle_1: Meet the people who make your product
angle_2: Your supplier list, or your plan to publish it
risk: If you can't answer the question, don't ask it. Dates for 2027 not yet announced; the UK HQ closed in 2026 and the movement now runs through its global network.

name: Mental Health Awareness Month (US)
cause: Mental health awareness and access to care
ask: Talk about it, check in, find support
join_only_if: you support, not sell: you have a policy, a resource or a partner to share
angle_1: What your team does to switch off
angle_2: How you support staff mental health
angle_3: Where to find help (link official services)
risk: Support, don't sell. No therapeutic claims. Always link official services.

name: World Bee Day
fit: Food, honey, gardens, cosmetics with bee ingredients
join_only_if: your product or place depends on pollinators
angle_1: How many of your ingredients rely on pollinators
angle_2: A bee-friendly planting tip
angle_3: A local beekeeper you work with
risk: Avoid claims of 'saving the bees'.

name: International Day for Biological Diversity
ask: Learn about and protect local nature
join_only_if: your business touches land, sea or supply chains in nature
angle_1: A local plant or animal near your business
angle_2: How you source responsibly
risk: Back claims with specifics.

name: World No Tobacco Day
join_only_if: you have a health or workplace role
angle_1: How you support staff who want to quit
angle_2: Official quit resources
risk: Stay with official health guidance.

name: Pride Month
organiser: Local Pride organisations (major events in some markets fall in other months)
ask: Celebrate, support and show up for LGBTQ+ people
markets: US, PH, NZ, SG (community events), AU (major events in Feb and Mar)
join_only_if: you support LGBTQ+ people all year: policies, partners, giving, people
angle_1: Your team's own voices, with consent
angle_2: A community partner and what you fund
risk: Rainbow-washing gets called out. Check local rules and norms for each market before you post.

name: World Environment Day
cause: Environmental action; 2027 host Serbia, theme Play for Humanity: Sport and Music for All
ask: Take part in the year's campaign
join_only_if: you can show a change you've made
angle_1: This year's theme, applied to your business
angle_2: A measured change
risk: Tie your post to the 2027 theme only if you have a real link to it.

name: World Oceans Day
join_only_if: your business touches the sea, seafood or plastic
angle_1: Where your seafood comes from
angle_2: A beach clean you'll join
risk: Seafood sourcing claims need certification.

name: World Refugee Day
fit: Employers, food (refugee cooks and makers), social enterprises
join_only_if: you employ, partner with or fund refugee-led work
angle_1: A colleague's story, told by them, with consent
angle_2: A refugee-led partner
risk: Never use people's stories without consent. Keep it about people, not politics.

name: Dry July
cause: Raising funds for people affected by cancer by going alcohol-free
ask: Go alcohol-free for July and raise funds
join_only_if: your team or venue takes part or offers alcohol-free options
angle_1: Your team's fundraising page and progress
angle_2: Your alcohol-free menu
risk: Alcohol brands should sit this out. Be exact about where funds go.

name: Plastic Free July
ask: Choose to refuse single-use plastic for July
join_only_if: you've cut plastic or offer a real alternative
angle_1: Packaging you've removed, with the number
angle_2: A refill or bring-your-own offer
risk: 'Plastic-free' claims must be true for the whole product and pack.

name: NAIDOC Week
date_display: Sun 4 Jul to Sun 11 Jul 2027 (First Sunday in July to the following Sunday (preliminary))
cause: Celebrating the history, culture and achievements of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples
join_only_if: you have a genuine relationship with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people or organisations
angle_1: A local event your team attends
angle_2: An Indigenous-owned partner, with consent
risk: Follow NAIDOC's guidelines on the theme and logo. Never use cultural material without permission. Dates are preliminary.

name: Earth Overshoot Day
date_display: Date announced each year (Announced around June; in 2026 it fell on 30 July)
ask: Help move the date back with practical solutions
join_only_if: you can show a solution that uses fewer resources
angle_1: One solution from your business and what it saves
angle_2: What #MoveTheDate means for your industry
risk: Date depends on the yearly calculation; plan once it's announced. Back every claim.

name: International Youth Day
join_only_if: you hire, train or serve young people
angle_1: Your youngest team member takes over
angle_2: An internship or first-job story
risk: Avoid stereotypes about generations.

name: World Humanitarian Day
cause: Aid workers and people in crisis
join_only_if: you support humanitarian work in a concrete way
angle_1: A partner you support and how
angle_2: A volunteer on your team
angle_3: How customers can help, through a trusted channel
risk: Never use crisis imagery to sell.

name: International Day of Charity
ask: Give time or money to a cause
fit: Any brand with a giving programme
join_only_if: you give, and can show it
angle_1: Who you support and why
angle_2: How customers can join in
risk: Be exact about amounts and where money goes.

name: International Literacy Day
join_only_if: you make, sell or support reading
angle_1: Your team's favourite books
angle_2: A book drive or donation
risk: Keep it practical.

name: World Cleanup Day
date_display: Mon 20 Sep 2027 (UN day 20 Sep (resolution 78/122); many clean-ups run Sat 18 or Sun 19 Sep)
type: Day (events often on the weekend before)
organiser: UN (UN-Habitat facilitates), with the Let's Do It World movement
fit: Retail, F&B, packaging, local businesses, teams
join_only_if: your team will take part
angle_1: Your team's clean-up, in photos
angle_2: What you collected and what it taught you
risk: Show the work, not the logo.

name: International Day of Peace
join_only_if: you have something meaningful to add
angle_1: A community project you support
angle_2: A message from your team
angle_3: A moment of quiet in your stores or office
risk: Keep it non-political and sincere.

name: Breast Cancer Awareness Month
organiser: Breast cancer charities in each market (for example the National Breast Cancer Foundation in Australia)
cause: Breast cancer awareness, screening and research
join_only_if: you give to a named charity and can say how much and how
angle_1: Your donation, with the exact amount or percentage
angle_2: Official screening guidance
risk: 'Pinkwashing' gets called out. Say exactly what you give. No health claims.

name: International Day of Older Persons
join_only_if: you serve or employ older people
angle_1: An older team member or customer, in their words
angle_2: Accessibility you've improved
risk: Avoid stereotypes.

name: World Teachers' Day
join_only_if: you work with or for teachers
angle_1: A thank-you from your team to a teacher
angle_2: A free resource for teachers
risk: Singapore marks its own Teachers' Day in September (a school holiday in Mavic's Holidays panel).

name: World Mental Health Day
organiser: World Federation for Mental Health (UN observance)
join_only_if: you support, not sell: you have a policy, resource or partner to share
angle_1: How your team takes breaks
angle_2: What you changed for staff wellbeing
risk: Support, don't sell. No therapeutic claims. Always link official services.

name: World Food Day
cause: Food security and better food systems
ask: Waste less, share more, support food security
join_only_if: food is your business
angle_1: Food waste you've cut, with the number
angle_2: Where your ingredients come from
risk: Back sourcing and waste claims with numbers.

name: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty
join_only_if: you have a concrete programme or partner
angle_1: Your partner and what you fund
angle_2: Fair pay in your supply chain
angle_3: How customers can help through trusted charities
risk: Never use poverty imagery to sell.

name: Movember
cause: Men's health: mental health, prostate and testicular cancer
ask: Grow a moustache, move, host, give
join_only_if: your team takes part or you give to Movember
angle_1: Your team's Mo progress
angle_2: A fundraising goal and where it stands
angle_3: How to check in on a mate (Movember's own resources)
risk: Link Movember's resources for health topics. Be exact about donations.

name: World Kindness Day
fit: Any brand, especially community and service brands
join_only_if: you can do something kind, not just post about it
angle_1: A kind act by your team, done before you post
angle_2: A customer who was kind to you
angle_3: An invitation to pass it on
risk: Don't make kindness transactional ('buy one to be kind').

name: GivingTuesday
date_display: Tue 30 Nov 2027 (Tuesday after US Thanksgiving (25 Nov 2027))
ask: Give, volunteer, or share a cause
fit: Any brand with a giving programme; nonprofits
join_only_if: you give, and can show it
angle_1: What you're giving and to whom
angle_2: Match customer donations, with a cap and a deadline
risk: Be exact about matches, caps and where money goes.

name: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
join_only_if: you've made something more accessible, or are working on it
angle_1: An accessibility fix you made
angle_2: A disabled team member or customer, in their words, with consent
angle_3: How to use your product with assistive tech
risk: Nothing about us without us: involve disabled people.

name: International Volunteer Day
join_only_if: your team volunteers
angle_1: Your team's volunteer hours and where
angle_2: A volunteer customer's story
angle_3: An open invitation to join you
risk: Show the work.

name: Human Rights Day
join_only_if: your practices back it up (fair work, supply chain)
angle_1: A right your business protects, in practice
angle_2: Your supplier code, in plain words
risk: Avoid taking political sides; keep to your own practice.
